note: Topics are organised around Cambridge Primary Stage 6 learning objectives. All questions and lessons on this site are original.

topics.name: Number and place value
objectives: Read, write and compare whole numbers and decimals
Round to the nearest 10, 100, 1000 and to one decimal place

topics.name: Operations and calculation
objectives: Use mental strategies and written methods for the four operations
Recognise factors, multiples, primes, squares and cubes

topics.name: Fractions
objectives: Multiply and divide fractions by whole numbers

topics.name: Decimals and percentages
objectives: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages

topics.name: Ratio and proportion
objectives: Share an amount in a given ratio

topics.name: Sequences and expressions
objectives: Use the term-to-term and position-to-term rule

topics.name: Measurement
objectives: Read scales and solve time problems

topics.name: Statistics and probability
objectives: Interpret tables, bar charts, line graphs and pie charts
Calculate mean, median, mode and range
Describe probability and find simple probabilities

topics.name: Human body and health
objectives: Describe the heart, blood vessels and circulation
Describe digestion and the organs involved
Explain how diet and exercise affect health
Know the functions of major organs

topics.name: Plants
objectives: Describe what plants need to grow
Explain the roles of roots, stem, leaves and flowers
Describe pollination, seed dispersal and germination
Know that plants make their own food using light

topics.name: Living things and environments
objectives: Construct and interpret food chains and webs
Explain how animals and plants are adapted to habitats
Describe human impact on the environment

topics.name: Materials and states of matter
objectives: Describe properties of solids, liquids and gases using the particle model
Explain melting, freezing, evaporation, condensation and boiling
Compare properties of materials and their uses

topics.name: Mixtures and changes
objectives: Describe dissolving and factors that affect it
Separate mixtures by sieving, filtering and evaporating

topics.name: Forces and motion
objectives: Describe forces including gravity, friction, air resistance and upthrust
Know the difference between mass and weight

topics.name: Electricity and magnetism
objectives: Build and draw circuits with standard symbols
Predict the effect of changing a circuit

topics.name: Light and sound
objectives: Explain how we see objects and how shadows form
Explain how sounds are made and travel
Relate pitch and loudness to vibrations

topics.name: Earth and space
objectives: Describe the Moon's phases and the solar system
Describe rocks, soils and the rock cycle
Describe Earth's structure, volcanoes and earthquakes

topics.name: Planning investigations and variables
objectives: Identify independent, dependent and control variables
Choose suitable equipment and identify risks

topics.name: Observations, data and conclusions
objectives: Interpret tables, bar charts and line graphs

topics.name: Reading: inference and interpretation
objectives: Support ideas with evidence from the text

topics.name: Language analysis
objectives: Explain the effect of word choices
Comment on the writer's viewpoint and tone

topics.name: Text organisation and purpose
objectives: Identify purpose, audience and text type
Recognise features of different text types

topics.name: Vocabulary
objectives: Use prefixes, suffixes and root words
Choose precise vocabulary, synonyms and antonyms

topics.name: Punctuation and spelling
objectives: Use commas, apostrophes and speech marks correctly
Use colons, semicolons, brackets and dashes
